FROM dim_date WHERE (calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24') OR (calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') GROUP BY fiscal_year

WITH p AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END AS yr, f.*, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT yr, CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN 'store' ELSE CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) END AS loc, channel_code, staff_purchase_flag,
  count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl, sum(net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
  count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS n_loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS mn_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS mx_load
FROM p GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END AS yr, s.store_id,
    sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_incl, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_excl_staff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') GROUP BY ALL),
rets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END AS yr, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds, count(*) AS n_ret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS n_ret_ids
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') GROUP BY ALL),
rp AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END AS yr, store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS rpt_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT st.store_id, coalesce(sa.yr, rp.yr) AS yr, sa.gross_incl, sa.gross_excl_staff, re.refunds, re.n_ret, re.n_ret_ids, rp.rpt_gross, rp.rpt_ret, rp.rpt_net, rp.rpt_days
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900) st
LEFT JOIN sales sa ON sa.store_id=st.store_id
FULL JOIN rp ON rp.store_id=st.store_id AND rp.yr=sa.yr
LEFT JOIN rets re ON re.store_id=st.store_id AND re.yr=coalesce(sa.yr,rp.yr)
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS n_days, sum(r.net_sales) AS net_sales, sum(r.receipts) AS receipts
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id IN (127,109) AND d.fiscal_period IN (3,4,5) AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id,
    max(open_date) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS open_date, max(close_date) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS close_date
  FROM dim_store WHERE store_id < 900),
sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, st.open_date, st.close_date,
    sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ty, sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ly
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date JOIN stores st ON st.store_id=r.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT 'fiscal_year FY2026/27 P4' AS basis,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28') AND ty IS NOT NULL AND ly IS NOT NULL) AS n_lfl,
  sum(ty) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')) AS ty_lfl,
  sum(ly) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')) AS ly_lfl,
  round(100*(sum(ty) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')) / sum(ly) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')) - 1),2) AS lfl_pct,
  round(100*(sum(ty) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL) / sum(ly) FILTER (WHERE close_date IS NULL) - 1),2) AS pct_incl_136_137,
  round(100*(sum(ty) / sum(ly) - 1),2) AS naive_all_stores_pct,
  sum(ty) AS ty_all, sum(ly) AS ly_all
FROM sales

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE store_id < 900 AND store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING max(close_date) IS NULL AND (max(open_date) IS NULL OR max(open_date) <= DATE '2024-07-28')
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  round(100 * (sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN r.net_sales END) / sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END) - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
JOIN lfl_stores l ON l.store_id = r.store_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
